recommended_approach: Cell Fracture pre-fracture + per-shard Rigid Body + FIXED breakable constraint network (`use_breaking=True`) for progressive glass fracture, with the brick switched from kinematic to active at impact.
warnings: Constraint-based glass shattering is explicitly recommended for realism; basic prefracture alone is less realistic because it lacks progressive fracture propagation.
Use `substeps_per_frame`, not `steps_per_second`; the rigid body world pattern notes `steps_per_second` was removed in Blender 5.0.
Fast impacts can fail or look wrong unless the projectile is kinematic before impact and released to active rigid body at impact.
Without a secondary debris layer, the destruction can read too clean and miss small glass chips.

The rigid-body API lookup returned some irrelevant armature/class-registration references, so the strongest grounding here comes from the destruction technique docs and proven code patterns rather than clean API-reference hits.
alternative_approaches: Basic pre-fractured rigid body glass without breakable constraints (simpler setup, less realistic than progressive constraint breaking).
Cell Fracture complete glass shatter workflow using many rigid body shards but no adjacency constraint network.
Rigid body shard sim plus a separate particle debris pass for micro-chips and dust-like secondary breakup.
